action.description: list agents, get full config, or apply a partial update.

agentId.description: Target agent id (agt_…), required for get/update.

patch.description: Partial update. Writable fields: displayName, bio, system, tools, skills, metadata (object of string→string), model, memory. memory is the agent's long-term memory binding and disclosure scope (tag:… / note:<nb>::<path> / collection:<id>); shrinking is allowed here, adding sources must be done in the app's Agent page.
